hyde_map.Q001: In ART and RawTherapee, the Auto Levels tool analyzes the image raw histogram. It evaluates the distribution of highlights and shadows to adjust exposure settings, specifically adjusting Exposure Compensation, Highlight Compression, and Black level sliders to achieve a balanced exposure.
hyde_map.Q002: RawTherapee Highlight Reconstruction offers Color Propagation mode. It reconstructs clipped highlight channels by propagating known chromaticity from adjacent unclipped channels. While effective for small areas, its limitation is potential color bleeding into incorrect neighboring image regions.
hyde_map.Q003: The Dynamic Range Compression tool compresses the global dynamic range while preserving local contrast. The Anchor slider specifies the tonal anchor point around which tones are preserved, determining which midtone levels remain unaffected while compressing shadows and highlights.
hyde_map.Q004: In Dynamic Range Compression, the Amount slider governs the overall compression intensity of the dynamic range, lifting shadows and compressing highlights. The Detail slider boosts local contrast, restoring fine texture sharpness that might be softened during dynamic range compression.
hyde_map.Q005: In Shadows & Highlights, working in RGB color space instead of Lab allows faster computation and avoids some chromatic aberration artifacts in saturated areas. However, RGB mode can lead to hue shifts or desaturation when compressing shadows or highlights heavily.
hyde_map.Q006: The Tonal Width slider in Shadows & Highlights controls the range of tones considered shadows or highlights, restricting adjustments to deep tones or extending them into midtones. The Radius slider sets the local neighborhood filter size, preventing halo artifacts around high-contrast edges.
hyde_map.Q007: The Gamma slider in the Tone Mapping module modifies the non-linear luminance compression curve. It adjusts the distribution of intermediate luminance values, brightening midtones without clipping highlights, following the Fattal tone mapping algorithm formulation.
hyde_map.Q008: When Tone Mapping produces an unnatural, cartoonish appearance or soft halos around high-contrast boundaries, increasing the Reweighting Iterates setting recalculates edge-stopping weights, significantly suppressing halos and smoothing artifacts.
hyde_map.Q009: In the Local Contrast module, the Amount slider controls the intensity of local tonal edge enhancement. Increasing Amount enhances the separation between neighboring light and dark areas, making image textures appear punchier without altering global contrast.
hyde_map.Q010: In Local Contrast, Darkness Level and Lightness Level adjust local contrast separately in dark and light regions. If both Darkness and Lightness Level sliders are set to 0, the local contrast adjustment is effectively neutralized, leaving the image unchanged.
hyde_map.Q011: Luminosity Mode in RGB Curves applies contrast and tone curves strictly to luminance while keeping color hue and saturation relatively stable, preventing the oversaturation often introduced by standard RGB channel curves.
hyde_map.Q012: Applying individual RGB curves to red, green, and blue channels separately in RawPedia documentation allows cross-processing and color grading effects, introducing creative color casts and split-toning between highlights and shadows.
hyde_map.Q013: The Clipping Indication feature alerts the photographer when pixels exceed sensor or output limits. Clipped highlights are flagged when one or more color channels reach the maximum white point threshold, displayed as colored warning overlays.
hyde_map.Q014: In the Haze Removal tool, enabling the depth or transmission preview map allows the user to visually inspect the estimated atmospheric haze distribution across the image scene to verify which regions receive the strongest correction.
hyde_map.Q015: The Soft Light tool emulates the soft light blending mode found in photo editors, enhancing local contrast, rich color saturation, and gentle tonal glow across the image.
hyde_map.Q016: When exporting images using an Unclipped profile to retain floating point specular highlights, the recommended workflow requires an unbounded floating-point output ICC profile and saving in 16-bit or 32-bit TIFF format.
hyde_map.Q017: The White Balance temperature slider adjusts image warmth along the blue to amber (yellow) color temperature axis, altering Kelvin values to compensate for warm tungsten or cool daylight illumination.
hyde_map.Q018: In raw processing, White Balance applies multipliers to red and blue channels relative to green. Temperature correlation algorithms can miscalculate white balance under non-standard spectra such as narrowband LED or fluorescent lighting.
hyde_map.Q019: In Color Management, if a dedicated camera input color profile is missing, raw sensor RGB values cannot be mapped accurately into the working color space, resulting in severe color distortion and unnatural skin tones.
hyde_map.Q020: RawTherapee recommends wide-gamut working profiles such as ProPhoto RGB or Rec.2020 to prevent color clipping during processing. The output profile then maps colors appropriately for web sRGB or print media.
hyde_map.Q021: Gamut Compression compresses out-of-gamut saturated colors smoothly into the boundaries of the working color space, preventing hard clipping and retaining tonal gradients in highly saturated lighting.
hyde_map.Q022: In Gamut Compression, the Threshold slider determines the saturation boundary where compression begins. Working spaces marked with an asterisk feature precalculated optimum threshold values tailored to their boundaries.
hyde_map.Q023: The Film Simulation tool requires a reference HaldCLUT image in PNG or TIFF format to apply precise 3D color lookup transformations that emulate classic analog film emulsions.
hyde_map.Q024: When generating identity HaldCLUT files, certain third-party software packages suffer from an arithmetic clipping bug that damages highlight values; documentation warns against using these bug-prone tools.
hyde_map.Q025: In the CIE Lab color space, the L channel represents perceptual Lightness, closely matching human non-linear perception of brightness independently of color chromaticity channels a and b.
hyde_map.Q026: The Chromaticity slider in Lab Adjustments scales color saturation along both a and b axes. Setting Chromaticity to -100 completely strips color from the image, converting it into a neutral monochrome photograph.
hyde_map.Q027: The Vibrance tool boosts muted colors while preserving already saturated areas. It provides separate sliders for Pastel Tones and Saturated Tones to give nuanced control over color intensity.
hyde_map.Q028: To avoid over-saturating human portrait subjects in the Vibrance tool, users can toggle the Protect skin tones option, which shields skin hue ranges from excessive saturation boost.
hyde_map.Q029: In the Black-and-White module, the Color Filter emulates traditional camera lens colored glass filters, lightening areas matching the filter color and darkening complementary hues in the monochrome rendition.
hyde_map.Q030: Alternative ways to produce monochrome images in RawTherapee without the Black-and-White tool include setting Lab Chromaticity to -100, desaturating via the Channel Mixer, or applying a dedicated monochrome HaldCLUT.
hyde_map.Q031: RGB color spaces define colors additively through primary channels, whereas CIE Lab models human vision using lightness and opponent color axes, allowing luminance adjustments without altering color balance.
hyde_map.Q032: The Channel Mixer mixes red, green, and blue raw channel contributions to generate composite output channels, useful for creative color grading, infrared simulation, and monochrome conversion.
hyde_map.Q033: Camera sensors deviate from ideal human spectral sensitivity curves. Dedicated DCP (DNG Camera Profile) color profiles provide dual-illuminant color matrices and tone curves to correct sensor-specific color deviations.
hyde_map.Q034: The ICC Profile Creator tool allows photographers to generate custom ICC camera input profiles by measuring target color patches from standard color checker charts under calibrated lighting.
hyde_map.Q035: Most digital camera sensors use a Bayer filter CFA mosaic arranged in 2x2 pixel blocks consisting of one red, two green, and one blue photo-site (RGGB or BGGR matrix).
hyde_map.Q036: Dual Demosaic combines AMaZE for detailed high-frequency areas and VNG4 for smooth low-frequency areas, reducing demosaicing artifacts at the expense of doubled computational time and processing overhead.
hyde_map.Q037: Hot pixels in sensor preprocessing occur due to elevated leakage current in individual defective photosites during long exposure or high temperature, appearing as isolated bright spots.
hyde_map.Q038: Due to manufacturing variations, the two green photosites in a Bayer block can exhibit slight sensitivity differences, causing maze artifacts. Green Equilibration sets a threshold to balance both green channels.
hyde_map.Q039: Flat-Field correction compensates for optical lens vignetting, sensor dust spots, and lens color cast. Flat field calibration frames should be captured at the camera base ISO.
hyde_map.Q040: Dark-frame subtraction captures thermal fixed-pattern noise and hot pixel artifacts during long exposure photography, subtracting these sensor defects from the primary exposure.
hyde_map.Q041: The Raw Black Points tool establishes the baseline black level for raw photosites, preventing shadows from appearing lifted and murky or crushed into clipped black.
hyde_map.Q042: The Raw White Points tool defines the maximum saturation level of raw photosites, ensuring that specular highlights reach pure white without premature pink or magenta clipping.
hyde_map.Q043: The Chromatic Aberration correction tool in the Raw tab operates directly on Bayer raw sensor data before demosaicing, eliminating lateral chromatic aberration fringing at the earliest stage.
hyde_map.Q044: Higher bit depth representations (such as 16-bit or 32-bit floating point) provide greater dynamic range and eliminate posterization in extreme tonal adjustments, but require larger memory and storage.
hyde_map.Q045: In Flat-Field correction, the Blur Radius slider default of 32 smooths fine dust texture while preserving large-scale illumination gradients; setting it to 0 applies flat-field pixel data directly without smoothing.
hyde_map.Q046: In RawTherapee Preferences under Image Processing, the Dark-Frame directory path specifies the folder where calibration dark frames are stored for automatic exposure matching.
hyde_map.Q047: Capture Sharpening compensates for blur caused by optical diffraction, anti-aliasing optical low-pass filters, and minor lens softness right after demosaicing.
hyde_map.Q048: When using Richardson-Lucy RL Deconvolution in Capture Sharpening, adjusting the radius and contrast threshold prevents noise amplification and ringing halos across high-contrast edges.
hyde_map.Q049: Unsharp Mask (USM) sharpening is a classic method that enhances perceived edge sharpness by creating high-contrast edge boundaries between adjacent bright and dark pixels.
hyde_map.Q050: Halo Control in USM suppresses white and dark ringing along sharp edges, while RL Deconvolution models optical blur via a Point Spread Function (PSF) to reverse diffraction computationally.
hyde_map.Q051: Luminance noise appears as fine monochromatic grain and is often visually acceptable, whereas chrominance noise produces distracting blotchy color speckles that should be prioritized for removal.
hyde_map.Q052: Applying AMaZE demosaicing to noisy high-ISO raw files can produce distinctive maze-like artifact patterns along fine lines; switching to IGV or LMMSE demosaicing mitigates this effect.
hyde_map.Q053: Contrast by Detail Levels decomposes image luminance into wavelet frequency bands across five detail sliders, ranging from fine pixel structures (Slider 0) to coarse regional features (Slider 5).
hyde_map.Q054: Adjusting Contrast by Detail Levels sliders above 1.0 boosts contrast at that specific wavelet scale, while values below 1.0 soften features, useful for skin smoothing or haze softening.
hyde_map.Q055: The Edges tool enhances sharp boundaries without producing the aggressive halos typical of USM, operating in a specialized edge-preserving color space to keep noise contained.
hyde_map.Q056: Microcontrast refers to contrast across minute adjacent pixel details, distinct from local contrast which operates across broader regional tonal transitions in the scene.
hyde_map.Q057: Impulse Noise Reduction targets isolated extreme noise spikes, such as salt-and-pepper noise, operating early in the processing pipeline before demosaicing or wavelets.
hyde_map.Q058: Defringe targets purple fringing caused by longitudinal chromatic aberration and sensor microlens flare, appearing along overexposed high-contrast backlit edges.
hyde_map.Q059: RT-spots in RawTherapee and ART local adjustments emulate the U-Point control point technology pioneered in Nik Software, using spatial coordinates and color similarity to define masks.
hyde_map.Q060: An RT-spot comprises a central control point C and four boundary markers (TBLR), defining an elliptical area with Dissymetry, Transition, and Color gradient falloffs for local adjustments.
hyde_map.Q061: Local Lab Controls implements an intuitive graphical interface on the image preview, enabling direct manipulation of control points without navigating deep nested tool menus.
hyde_map.Q062: In Local Lab Controls, the Scope slider controls the deltaE color tolerance threshold across quadrants, expanding or shrinking the active selection based on color and luminance similarity.
hyde_map.Q063: To add a new spot in the Spot Removal tool, the user performs a Ctrl-click on the target artifact in the image editor window and drags to define the spot area and source patch.
hyde_map.Q064: Existing spots in Spot Removal are deleted by selecting the spot and pressing the Delete key or using the right-click context menu, toggling edit mode via the tool header button.
hyde_map.Q065: The Graduated Filter tool digitally emulates physical graduated neutral density (GND) lens filters, balancing high-contrast skies against darker foreground landscapes.
hyde_map.Q066: The Graduated Filter tool specifies application intensity using exposure values (EV stops) in its Strength slider.
hyde_map.Q067: When a crop is applied to an image, the Vignetting Filter can position its radial vignetting effect relative to either the cropped image frame or the original uncropped canvas.
hyde_map.Q068: Artistic vignetting applies stylized radial shading, whereas Flat-Field and Raw Tab corrections eliminate unwanted optical lens falloff; both circular and rectangular shapes can be configured.
hyde_map.Q069: Focus mask in Preview Modes highlights in-focus sharp image areas with a colored overlay, allowing rapid verification of critical focus in portraits or landscapes.
hyde_map.Q070: In the RawTherapee tutorial rocks.md, selective editing demonstrates 5 RT-spots, where the first spot applies Generalized Hard Shading (GHS) and tone adjustments to foreground rocks.
hyde_map.Q071: In RawTherapee, PP3 processing sidecar profiles are saved to disk upon switching images, closing the editor, sending a job to the batch queue, or pressing the manual Save button.
hyde_map.Q072: When applying partial profiles in RawTherapee, Fill mode sets unmentioned parameters to defaults, whereas Preserve mode keeps existing values unchanged, updating only specified settings.
hyde_map.Q073: Using Save immediately in the editor tab causes full image processing synchronously, temporarily freezing the interface, whereas the batch Queue processes jobs asynchronously in the background.
hyde_map.Q074: To avoid overwriting existing files when saving multiple versions, RawTherapee offers auto-numbering and suffix options in the Save dialog when queuing files.
hyde_map.Q075: In RawTherapee Queue file template naming, %f substitutes the original filename, %d1 substitutes the parent folder, %p1 substitutes the path, and %r substitutes the image rank rating.
hyde_map.Q076: Enabling Force saving options forces global queue tab settings over individual Save dialog settings, while Queue persistence retains uncompleted tasks across application restarts.
hyde_map.Q077: Creating reusable processing profiles via Ctrl+Save allows selecting only universal adjustments like Auto Levels, while excluding camera-specific exposure, white balance, or noise reduction.
hyde_map.Q078: In the File Browser Sync panel, Set mode completely replaces selected image parameters with the copied values, whereas Add mode adds relative adjustments to existing parameters.
hyde_map.Q079: The Resize tool runs near the end of the processing pipeline, offering post-resize unsharp masking to recover fine edge sharpness lost during downscaling.
hyde_map.Q080: The RawTherapee config directory stores user preferences and profiles, while the cache directory stores thumbnails and preview images; deleting cache/images frees disk space without losing settings.
hyde_map.Q081: In GitHub Discussion #412, building ART on Windows requires updating MSYS2 and installing packages. In VS Code, the user configures the CMake Kit for GCC x86_64 and selects ART as the Launch Target.
hyde_map.Q082: In GitHub Discussion #420, integrating Flatpak PhotoGIMP as an external editor in ART requires a wrapper shell script that passes the image file argument using flatpak run org.photogimp.PhotoGIMP "$@".
hyde_map.Q083: In GitHub Discussion #420, linking Flatpak PhotoGIMP requires creating a shell script with chmod +x permissions and entering its executable path in ART Preferences under External Editors.
hyde_map.Q084: In GitHub Discussion #424, Film Simulation 3D LUTs are restricted to point-wise color transformations that cannot inspect neighboring pixels. For spatial effects like halation and film grain, ART provides dedicated tools in Local Editing.
hyde_map.Q085: In GitHub Discussion #440, since the ART file browser lacks a direct Move context menu item, users can organize files by using drag-and-drop between folders or configuring custom external script actions.
hyde_map.Q086: In GitHub Discussion #442, a mask created in one tool can be reused by assigning it a custom name. Subsequent downstream tools in the pipeline can then access it as a dynamic Linked mask.
hyde_map.Q087: In GitHub Discussion #442, Linked masks can only reference upstream tools in pipeline order, updating dynamically. In contrast, copy/paste duplicates static parameters without live linkage.
hyde_map.Q088: In GitHub Discussion #489, creating an ellipse mask in ART local editing involves using an Area mask with shape parameters, adjusting radius and aspect ratio to form the desired oval contour.
hyde_map.Q089: In GitHub Discussion #494, Fedora Flatpak ART cannot access external storage due to Flatpak sandboxing restrictions. Granting filesystem permissions via Flatseal or flatpak override resolves the issue.
hyde_map.Q090: In GitHub Issue #477, reports of tone curve distortion and black borders on Sony Alpha A7 V lossless .ARW files were resolved in the dev branch with updated raw decoding and camconst settings.
hyde_map.Q091: In GitHub Issue #500, ART exports JPEG XL (JXL) files using fixed lossless or default high-quality compression settings, without exposing detailed manual compression tuning sliders.
hyde_map.Q092: In GitHub Issue #516, Canon EOS R8 raw files displaying solid white were resolved by updating libraw and building with the latest master or official AppImage containing updated camera constants.
hyde_map.Q093: In GitHub Issue #521, an Xubuntu user resolved disabled lens correction profiles by setting the lensfun database path in the ART options configuration file to point to the system directory.
hyde_map.Q094: In GitHub Issue #524, a crash in ART 1.26.8 and early nightly ART-165b246-linux64 was investigated and resolved in subsequent nightly build releases addressing memory access in local editing.
hyde_map.Q095: In GitHub Issue #524, reproducing the spot removal crash required zooming to 100% with spot removal enabled. The developer recommended building with CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug to capture a stack trace.
hyde_map.Q096: In GitHub Issue #500, there is no procedure to enable a dedicated JPEG XL (JXL) quality slider to set compression to 50 in ART, because ART export options for JXL do not support customizable quality sliders.
hyde_map.Q097: In GitHub Discussion #424, a single 3D LUT file cannot implement spatial halation operations in Film Simulation because LUTs are point-wise color lookups that cannot perform spatial neighborhood calculations.
hyde_map.Q098: In GitHub Discussion #424, Film Simulation 3D LUTs cannot internally compute spatial film grain algorithms, as LUT transforms do not support pixel neighborhood calculations.
hyde_map.Q099: In GitHub Discussion #442, an upstream tool cannot link to a named mask defined in a downstream tool via Linked mask, because the pipeline strictly enforces single-direction upstream-to-downstream mask flow.
hyde_map.Q100: In GitHub Discussion #442, copying and pasting a parametric mask across different tools in the pipeline cannot guarantee 100% identical pixel results due to differing underlying color representations at different pipeline stages.
